text:
maya: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for tenant 'Orchid' in eu-west-9. We need accelerated instance entitlements + ENI/IP increases for a new AWS account. Account ID: 987654321098.

maya: Requested capacity (initial): p5.24xlarge: 6, g5.12xlarge: 12, p4d.24xlarge: 2. These are for dedicated inference pools (mix of real-time and batch).

sam: Can you add why these numbers? rough QPS/latency/cost so support can prioritize.

maya: Sure — primary workload: low-latency chat with batching fallback. Peak concurrent requests ~450, 95p latency target <120ms for p5, batch jobs run in off-peak. Estimated monthly spend ~ $48k on instance runtime (just a forecast). Justification: production rollout for 1 customer and PLG staging.

leo: Networking note — if you plan one GPU per host with ENI per host we need subnet sizing. What's your node layout (gpus per instance, pods per node)?

maya: Node plan: p5.24xlarge -> 8 GPUs / node, g5.12xlarge -> 4 GPUs / node, p4d -> 8 GPUs / node. We expect ~2 pods per GPU average, so plan for ~ (6*8 + 12*4 + 2*8)*2 = ~ (48+48+16)*2 = 224 IPs peak. Spread across 3 AZs.

leo: Ok, that'll require increasing VPC IP quota and ENI limits. Which VPC/subnet are you using?

maya: New VPC, prefixed CIDR 10.40.0.0/16, subnets per AZ: 10.40.0.0/20, 10.40.16.0/20, 10.40.32.0/20. We'll reserve /20s to keep room for other teams. Asking for ENI quota bump to support 300 concurrent ENIs and VPC IPv4 limit increase to 1000 to be safe.

adrian: Also check service quotas for EFA and placement group per account if you use p4d/p5. We should request EC2 placement-group and EFA quotas too.

maya: Good call — adding: EFA interfaces for all AZs, placement group soft limit increase to 20, and instance-family specific accelerator quotas for p5/p4d/g5.

sam: I'll need the support-case text to paste. Can you add a short justification blob we can use?

maya: Copy for case: "Onboarding new tenant 'Orchid' in eu-west-9 under account 987654321098. Requesting AWS EC2 accelerator quotas and networking increases for production inference: p5.24xlarge x6, g5.12xlarge x12, p4d.24xlarge x2; EFA interfaces across 3 AZs; ENI quota to 300; VPC IPv4 addresses to 1000; placement-group limit to 20. Justification: production ML inference fleet for latency-sensitive customer; expected sustained utilization and compliance with placement/EFA requirements. Contact: maya@redwood.ai."

maya: I'll open the case now.

quota-bot: Created support case #SUP-202404-4472 for account 987654321098. Estimated response: 48-72 hours. Links: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case?id=SUP-202404-4472

leo: Tagging/network review: please add network owner 'leo' and include subnet route table + NAT design.

maya: Added tags: Owner=maya, Project=orchid, NetworkOwner=leo. Will attach proposed terraform snippet in follow-up.

sam: Also flag cost center and legal approval if EU data residency checks needed.

maya: Noted — legal looped in, cost center 2301.

adrian: Once case ack'd, we'll schedule a canary pool rollout to validate ENI behaviour and EFA. Keep me posted.

maya: Thanks — will post the support-case updates here.

quota-bot: Case SUP-202404-4472 updated: AWS support acknowledged and requested architecture details. Next update ETA 2024-04-30.
